content.title: Lithium Americas: Q2 Earnings Snapshot
content.summary: VANCOUVER, British Columbia (AP) — Lithium Americas (LAC) on Thursday reported a loss of $12.4 million in its second quarter. On a per-share basis, the Vancouver, British Columbia-based company said it had a loss of 6 cents. The results fell short of Wall Street expectations.

content.title: Lithium stocks rally as CATL mine halt raises prospects of tighter supply
content.summary: During morning trade, Albemarle Corp jumped 10.2%, while Chile's Sociedad Quimica y Minera, rose 9.2% and Lithium Americas, gained 2.4%.
